title: AMD action: lookup-patient
description: Search patients by name fragment or chart number; the primary way to resolve a name to a patient_id. Returns query, page, exactmatch, count, matches (full page), and narrow_query when AMD returned more than 50 rows.

first.description: Optional first name when building query as LAST,FIRST.

last.description: Optional last name when building query as LAST,FIRST.

page.description: Optional 1-based page index for paged enumeration (AARON-REVIEWABLE-2 / DUO-11 default: extend in-place rather than ship a second tool).

query.description: Name fragment or chart number to search.
